svg.text: 2 · Medallion architecture: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Data mart in Snowflake
Each layer has one job. Airflow runs the whole flow as one DAG of BashOperator tasks; dbt owns Silver, Gold and the Sales data mart.
AIRFLOW DAG wwi_snowflake_daily · @daily at 02:00 · every task is a plain BashOperator
Each task is one shell command — no decorators, no custom operators
dbt_run_mart = BashOperator(task_id='dbt_run_mart', bash_command='cd /opt/airflow/wwi_snowflake/dbt && dbt run --select mart_sales ...')
extract_load >> dbt_source_freshness >> dbt_run_silver >> dbt_snapshot >> dbt_test_silver >> dbt_run_gold >> dbt_test_gold >> dbt_run_mart >> dbt_test_mart >> reconcile
A failed task stops the DAG; fix and 'Clear' it in the UI to re-run from that task. Every load is idempotent (MERGE / batch_id).
